instruction: You are given a shock-tube template `/home/user/Desktop/shockTube_base/`. Complete a compressible shock-tube analysis from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/shockTube/`: - Build 1D tube geometry - Set different initial pressure and temperature on left and right to form a discontinuity - Configure compressible solver and fluid properties 2. Run the solver. 3. Extract the post-shock pressure plateau value. 4. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Post-shock pressure plateau `shock_pressure` - Format: `shock_pressure` 5. Do not use GUI tools.
